category: stage / End fight from a fixed kit / structured observations
objective: defeat the Ender Dragon and enter its exit portal
description: Stage course on the documented Java 1.16.1 speedrun seed. You start in the End on the obsidian arrival platform, having just come through the stronghold portal, with a fixed kit. Peaceful difficulty. If you die you respawn on the stronghold End portal frame in the Overworld without your items; stepping into the active portal block beside it returns you to the End.

landmarks.name: Stronghold End portal room: this portal block is already active

calibration: exploratory: 10 minutes of End fight; not a calibrated completion time
